sets.title: Invoice totals calculator with function name and call sites renamed
sets.description: The same computeTotals function in three calculator classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B renames the function to a shorter name; carrier C renames to a different name. The function definition and any internal call sites are renamed consistently (Type-2).
sets.notes: RN-03 (functions) renames the cloned symbol and all intra-clone call sites. Since computeTotals doesn't call itself recursively, the main effect is the function definition rename. Set 001 of 5.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice-domain vocabulary and foreach-over-items shape, but computes a histogram of line item prices — a different result
